# Preschool365

> > Preschool365 provides quality printable learning resources and activity packets for preschool through first grade, supporting homeschools and mainstream education with engaging worksheets across literacy, math, and science.

Preschool365 offers comprehensive early childhood education materials including free printables and premium activity packets designed for ages 3-7. The platform specializes in developmentally appropriate activities covering phonics, CVC words, sight words, number recognition, fine motor skills, and STEM-based science exploration.

## Key Topics

- Printable worksheets
- Preschool activities
- Early literacy
- CVC words
- Sight words
- Short vowel sounds
- Math activities
- Science activities
- Fine motor skills
- Language arts
- Kindergarten resources
- Homeschool materials
- Ages 3-5
- Ages 6-7
- Pre-writing skills

## Learning Levels by Age

- [Level 1: 3-Year-Olds](https://preschool365.com/level-1): Free learning printables for 3-year-olds featuring preschool activities and pre-writing skills development
- [Level 2: 4-5-Year-Olds (PreK)](https://preschool365.com/level-2): Quality learning resources for 4-5-year-old PreK children with literacy and math activities
- [Level 3: 6-7-Year-Olds (Kindergarten & 1st Grade)](https://preschool365.com/level-3): Quality learning resources for 6-7-year-old kindergarten and first grade children with science, language, and math activities

## Early Literacy & Language Arts

- [My Fun Letter-Sound Book](https://preschool365.com/product/my-fun-letter-sound-book-letter-tracing-sounding-and-identification-activity-packet): 26-page alphabet activity packet teaching letter tracing, sounds, and identification
- [My 3-Letter Word Book (CVC)](https://preschool365.com/product/my-3-letter-word-book-beginning-middle-ending-sounds-cvc): CVC phonics workbook teaching 3-letter words and short vowel sounds for early literacy
- [Short Vowel Sounds Picture Word Pocket Booklet](https://preschool365.com/product/short-vowel-sounds-picture-word-pocket-booklet): Pocket booklet with 28 pages of short vowel sounds and CVC word activities for preschoolers
- [My First 50 Sight Words Packet A](https://preschool365.com/product/my-first-50-sight-words-packet-4-7yr-olds): Sight words learning packet with 50 essential words for early readers ages 4-7

- [My Fun Book of Numbers (0-10)](https://preschool365.com/product/my-fun-book-of-numbers-0-10-tracing-counting-identification-packet): 62-page number activity packet with tracing, counting, and identification for ages 3-5
